description: Offline word search with a 300-level campaign, daily challenge and time attack A word search game for Android with no ads, no trackers and no internet access. The only permission is vibration. Game modes • Campaign with 300 levels across 10 worlds, progressive unlocking, up to 3 stars per level, timed levels and bosses • Free play on 6×6, 8×8, 10×10 and 12×12 boards, with three difficulty levels and 10 categories • Daily challenge: the same puzzle for everyone, generated from the date • Time attack: find as many words as you can before time runs out • Mystery word: a clue, words to find and a secret word to guess Details • Words in European Portuguese and English • Hints, statistics, best times and records • Colorblind mode, adjustable letter size and direction-assisted dragging • Two dark themes, code-generated sounds and layouts adapted to phones and tablets The game interface is in Portuguese (pt-PT). Open source under the MIT license.
